meaning:
γονυπετέω, -ῶ) (γόνυ, πίπτω);
1. to fall on the knees: before ἔμπροσθεν, Mat.27:29.
2. to fall down before one: with accusative, Mat.17:14, Mrk.1:40, R, txt., 10:17.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, and saying,
A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
